gates: Check handler, schema, registration/unload, coordinator, services.yaml, strings and every translation
Preserve backend ranking ownership, bounded responses and structured errors
Run affected recipe API/service tests including capability and idempotency branches
No live HA changes or release without explicit approval; HACS release requires a matching GitHub Release

always: Keep credentials out of URLs, prompts and logs; research authorizes no live HA changes.
EverShelf owns catalog/ranking business logic; HA preserves bounded response and service boundaries.

research: Inspect the source layer asked about; follow adjacent layers only when they can change the answer. A request builder does not prove backend execution.
Prefer existing integration helpers and use mocked/copy-based proposals rather than live probes.
validation: Run affected recipe API/service and replay/capability error tests.
release: Explicit release approval; a matching GitHub Release and HACS visibility are required, not a tag alone.
